title: Clean QPSK (high SNR)
narration: Deterministic QPSK capture for inspecting measured modulation, acquisition, and constellation evidence.

title: Structured BPSK/HDLC fixture
narration: Deterministic structured BPSK fixture. It is not presented as a validated concatenated-code demonstration.

title: OFDM (unsupported)
narration: Unsupported multicarrier fixture used to exercise explicit rejection.

title: Real-valued audio gate
narration: Real-valued fixture used to exercise semantic gating before single-carrier demodulation.

title: Clean 16-QAM (high SNR)
narration: Deterministic 16-QAM capture for configured receiver inspection.

narration: Deterministic structured 16-QAM fixture. Its legacy filename does not assert a validated FEC chain.

title: 64-QAM classifier limit
narration: Known classifier-limit fixture; inspect ambiguity and receiver evidence.
